precision: fp32 eager, TF32 disabled, no quantization/autocast
replay_batches: Original sorted per-direction groups of4 for IT2/NLLB; original single-row MADLAD batches. Match original decoder-cache policy. Recheck prior failed row before full preflight.
data: same 450 baseline meanings by 40 directions; intervention300 excluded; no generation, new corpus or historical fp16 tensors
revision_reason: CPU audit confirmed hash-dependent source placeholders; original process hash seed/token IDs were not recorded
purpose: new deterministic E4 raw baseline and all mask outcomes measured in the same forwards; old fp32 baseline preserved for comparison
baseline_reproduction: old baseline deltas reported separately; fresh same-input per-head repeat <=1e-6; actual source/reference IDs saved and checked
target_rows: freeze original model-specific lexical reference-label rows for all source-mask comparisons

source_masks.blank: strip SentencePiece/byte-BPE boundary markers and whitespace; empty remainder
source_masks.separator_localization: also save prefix blank mass before the first language-control position versus remaining body blanks; diagnostic subsets, not extra closure components
source_masks.punctuation_P: nonempty remainder consists entirely of Unicode category P characters
source_masks.symbol_control: remaining positions classified punctuation under original all-P/S/Z/C rule
source_masks.raw_P_only: original lexical mass + symbol/control mass; symbols treated as lexical under this alternative operational rule; blank remains nonlexical
source_masks.conditional_original: original lexical / (original lexical + original broad punctuation), excludes original controls
source_masks.conditional_no_separator: original lexical / (original lexical + pure punctuation + symbol/control), excludes blank separately
source_masks.harmonized_unknown: remove source unknown from numerator/denominator for all systems; original target support remains unchanged

word_count: raw original text: whitespace-separated groups containing at least one Unicode L/M/N character; orthographic estimate, not linguistic segmentation
fertility: full untruncated source lexical piece count / full original orthographic word estimate; encoded source length remains the exposure covariate; save source cap flags, content-only and corrected tokenizer-boundary counts
alternative_outcomes: fit language-only to raw Unicode-P-only, source unknown excluded, original conditional, separator-excluded conditional, P-only conditional, separator+unknown-excluded conditional
prediction: all20 reciprocal dyads held out; fit train315 meanings/38 directions, evaluate test68 meanings in the omitted directions; val67 not tuned on

bootstrap.unit: whole meanings jointly across all directions
bootstrap.prediction: paired test-meaning intervals conditional on fixed training fits
bootstrap.coefficient_stability: paired training-meaning refits using exact sufficient statistics
bootstrap.field_mask: descriptive all450 resampling; conditional on graph/languages; zero-energy fields marked undefined

coefficient_comparison: Spearman beta/theta rank stability, largest coefficient shift; 11 languages, effect sizes only, no population significance claim
numeric_design: train-only centering/scaling, deterministically drop constant/dependent numeric columns and record; no language term dropped
missingness: fail on incomplete data, corpus/target-support changes, changed frozen token IDs or same-input repeat failure; no silent exclusions
selection_status: MADLAD separator audit motivated by E3, therefore exploratory sensitivity; all mask rules frozen here before E4 outputs
release: private local protocol freeze; no public registration required, no GitHub changes
